_comment: Referee differential baseline (scripts/referee_differential.py --check). For each golden return: disagreements, arelle_errors and count_differences are held EXACTLY (a new entry fails, and so does one that went away unrecorded); rules_compared may not DECREASE. Re-measure with --update-baseline after a deliberate change and say why in _note; never type the entries.
_note: Banked 2026-11-13, when the gate was introduced. Five of the thirteen Basel 3.1 portfolios have an estate with no structure finding and are refereed; the other eight are not filed (they are the filing-mapping ratchet's structure_findings). Arelle accepts all five with no message at an error level, and its verdict on each of the 1,441 PRA001 rules is the native engine's, with no difference in evaluation counts. Reaching that took three changes to rwa_filer.boe, each found by this gate or by the all-tables oracle built alongside it: codes listed inside a reference are that variable's own range (boe_b0405); a rule that names one member of an open axis reads its other references across every member (boe_b0904, found on b31/off-bs); and a rule whose XBRL formula closes a dimension its cells carry is not evaluated (seven OF 91.01 rules).
